_comment: Painted (watercolour) look per stage, read by client/draw_style/draw_style.gd when the drawn style is on or lite. A map matches the first entry whose prefix starts its id. ground_a/ground_b: tileable textures laid over upward faces in world XZ (ground_b where the art is green, i.e. grass). tint 1 = the painting's hue at the art's brightness, 0 = only its light/dark strokes over the art colour. average = the texture's mean brightness as sampled (measured). offset/metres line the painting up with the modelled slabs (mummy: 2 m slabs centred on odd x, even z). grout: colour of the stage's collider floor box seen through the gaps between modelled slabs (else its grey-green ink wash reads as green grout). atlas: kit texture -> its palette-recoloured copy (Blender, tools/blender/recolour_atlas_from_palette.py). Textures: Codex watercolour set, PO-approved 2026-11-13 (docs/tech/draw_style.md).

stages._note: the painted floor tile is baked into the floor UVs (tools/blender/bake_mummy_floor_tile.py, art/maps/mummy_tomb/*_painted.glb), so no ground overlay here
